_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior above-grade foundation coating (poured concrete and CMU). Context prefix FNDN (FouNDatioN) — no collision with existing prefixes (CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, MSRY). Combined prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). Block filler module conditional on CMU. QT2-QT3 only — utilitarian surface. Ground-level access only.

paintable_items.name: Exterior above-grade foundation wall surface
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for exterior foundation wall. Covers above-grade visible band (typically 12-36 inches) on poured concrete and CMU foundations. SF-based — net paintable foundation area from PaintScope. foundation_type modifier (poured/CMU) adjusts prep sequence and material requirements. Surface ref 'foundation_wall' exists in id_registry surface_ids.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF (generic), FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD. Proposed sibling: MSRY. FNDN is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_FNDN_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_FNDN_WATER_WASH, TSK_FNDN_MOISTURE_TEST, TSK_FNDN_BLOCK_FILL_ROLL, TSK_FNDN_PRIME_ROLL, TSK_FNDN_FINISH_ROLL_1, TSK_FNDN_PROTECT_LANDSCAPE

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — landscape perimeter, hardscape walk/patio (when adjacent). Smaller protection scope than masonry wall.
Moisture testing (MC <= 4% hard stop), water wash, efflorescence treatment (conditional), form-release/laitance removal (poured only). No cure verification task — MC test subsumes it.
Block filler application — CMU only (PCA P12). Separate module from prep. Spray or roller. CONDITIONAL on foundation_type = CMU.
Alkali-resistant primer (mandatory on all new foundation — pH 12-14). Spray, roll, or brush.
Finish coat(s) — acrylic or cementitious. QT2 = 1 coat, QT3 = 2 coats. No interstage module (no QT4).
Final visual inspection and touch-up of foundation band.
Protection teardown, tool cleaning. Small scope — quick teardown.

paintscope_keys.description: Net paintable above-grade foundation wall area (square feet). Typically perimeter LF x band height (12-36 inches).
Boolean flag confirming new construction context. Always true for this NC spec.
Foundation substrate type (poured, CMU). Drives block filler requirement (CMU only), surface prep branching (form-release removal for poured, void filling for CMU), and roller nap selection.
paintscope_keys.notes: Project-level configuration. Most foundations are single type.

paintscope_keys.description: Linear feet of foundation perimeter where landscape is adjacent and requires protection.

quality_tier.notes: QT2-QT3 only. Foundation is utilitarian, not decorative. QT4/QT5 excluded — not warranted for low-visibility functional surface. QT2 = primer + 1 finish coat. QT3 = primer + 2 finish coats.

application_method.notes: Spray-only IS valid for foundation (unlike masonry walls) — foundation is a thin band, less textured poured concrete does not require forced pore penetration. CMU foundation with spray SHOULD include backroll per masonry doctrine — handled as conditional task in SOP, not as a separate application_method enum. Roll is typical primary method for small foundation band. Brush for detail work around pipes/vents.

sheen.notes: Flat only. Foundation is utilitarian — never decorative sheen. Cementitious coatings (Drylok-type) are inherently matte/flat. Acrylic option also flat for foundation.

phase.notes: No interstage module — QT2-QT3 only, no intercoat sanding warranted on utilitarian foundation. Block filler uses 'prep' phase (substrate preparation, not primer).

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for foundation wall. EA for protection items. LF for landscape perimeter. FIXED for moisture testing, tool cleaning.

substrate_state.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_MASONRY is the single NC state for both poured concrete and CMU. Both are cementitious substrates with same alkalinity. Output is always SS_EXT_PAINTED_FLAT (flat sheen only). SS_EXT_BARE_MASONRY is a proposed addition to controlled_enums.json (shared with masonry wall spec).

product_role.notes: Specialty for block filler (not a primer — fills voids). No sealer/clear/stain needed.

protection_level.notes: Exterior zones. Protection level upgrades by application method (brush < roll < spray). Foundation is a LOW protection spec — ground level, limited overspray risk.

surface_ids.notes: foundation_wall exists in id_registry surface_ids (confirmed at line 662). ext_siding_field and ext_trim_water_table are existing exterior surfaces. grade_line_soil is proposed — not a paintable surface, just an adjacency reference for edge termination. Foundation has NO edge work requirements — grade-line gap at siding provides natural termination, soil provides rough bottom edge.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_MSRY_PRIMER_ALKALI — sibling masonry spec uses same alkali-resistant primer concept. Foundation has different coverage rates (smaller area, different substrate context) but same product class.
SYS_EXT_MSRY_BLOCK_FILLER — sibling masonry spec uses same block filler concept for CMU. Foundation CMU uses identical product.

proposed_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Foundation Primer
proposed_systems.notes: Mandatory on ALL new foundation (pH 12-14). Reference product: SW Loxon Masonry Primer (rated to pH 13). Same product as masonry wall primer but separate system for foundation-specific coverage tracking. Allows 7-day accelerated coating vs 28-day standard cure.

proposed_systems.name: Block Filler for CMU Foundation (PCA P12)
proposed_systems.notes: Mandatory for CMU foundation. High-build block filler to fill open-cell voids (PCA P12 Level 2 Standard Fill). Not a primer — substrate preparation product. Applied before primer.

proposed_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for Foundation
proposed_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior masonry paint. Flat sheen. UV-resistant. Wider color range than cementitious. QT2 = 1 coat, QT3 = 2 coats on primed surface.

proposed_systems.name: Cementitious Coating for Foundation (Drylok-type)
proposed_systems.notes: Cementitious/crystalline coating (e.g., Drylok, UGL). Fills pores, breathable, matte finish only. Excellent adhesion to concrete. Budget-friendly. Withstands 15 PSI hydrostatic pressure. Thicker application than acrylic — lower coverage rate.

material_system_prefix.notes: 1 alkali-resistant primer (all foundation) + 1 block filler (CMU only) + 2 finish systems (acrylic OR cementitious). Oil-based and alkyd products are PROHIBITED on alkaline concrete/CMU — saponification risk. No elastomeric — overkill for above-grade cosmetic foundation coating.

proposed_consumables.name: Roller Cover 3/4 inch nap (foundation — poured concrete)
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard nap roller for smooth poured concrete foundation. Nylon/polyester blend for water-based products.

proposed_consumables.name: Roller Cover 1-1/4 inch nap (foundation — CMU)
proposed_consumables.notes: Heavy nap roller for porous CMU foundation. Same concept as CON_MSRY_ROLLER_THICK_NAP but foundation-specific tracking.

proposed_consumables.name: Plastic Sheeting for Foundation Protection
proposed_consumables.notes: 4 mil minimum. Landscape and hardscape overspray protection. Smaller quantities than masonry wall — foundation is ground-level small area.

proposed_consumables.name: TSP (Trisodium Phosphate) Cleaner
proposed_consumables.notes: For foundation washing and efflorescence treatment. 1 EA per ~500 SF. Same product as CON_MSRY_TSP.

proposed_consumables.name: Stiff Bristle Masonry Brush
proposed_consumables.notes: For efflorescence removal, form-release scrubbing, and foundation prep. Same product as CON_MSRY_STIFF_BRUSH.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 alkali-resistant primer + 1 finish coat — poured concrete at QT2
1 alkali-resistant primer + 2 finish coats — poured concrete at QT3
Block filler + 1 primer + 1 finish coat — CMU at QT2
Block filler + 1 primer + 2 finish coats — CMU at QT3

proposed_profiles.description: Alkali-resistant primer on bare foundation — 250-350 SF/gal. Poured concrete higher end, CMU lower end.
Block filler coverage on CMU foundation — 75-125 SF/gal depending on void density. Same range as masonry wall.
Acrylic finish on primed foundation — 250-350 SF/gal on poured concrete, 150-200 SF/gal on CMU.
Cementitious coating (Drylok-type) on primed foundation — 100-150 SF/gal. Thicker application than acrylic.

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Foundation is an isolated low-interaction spec. Siding protection above foundation is NOT this spec's responsibility — belongs in siding spec. No cross-spec flags needed.

existing_modifiers: FAC_EXT_ACCESS — ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50 (NOT USED — foundation is always ground level)

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by foundation substrate type
proposed_modifiers.notes: Poured concrete is baseline (smooth formed surface). CMU is 15% slower due to porous surface, voids, and more complex surface geometry. Same modifier pattern as FAC_MSRY_SUBSTRATE_TYPE but only 2 values (no brick/limestone for foundation).

factor_modifiers.access_note: FAC_EXT_ACCESS is NOT applicable to this spec. Foundation work is always at grade level. No height modifier. Sloped lots exposing extra foundation height are an edge case noted in research uncertainties but not modeled.

critical_rules.rule: NEVER caulk the siding-to-foundation gap. The 3/8-inch gap with Z-flashing is an intentional drainage plane. Caulking causes catastrophic moisture damage.
critical_rules.enforcement: SOP hard stop. Crew briefing note. Grade-line gap is MASKED, not sealed.

critical_rules.rule: Moisture content hard stop at 4% (MC <= 4%). Do NOT coat if MC exceeds 4%. Stricter than masonry wall spec (12%) due to continuous ground contact.
critical_rules.enforcement: SOP hard stop. Electronic moisture meter at multiple points. Document readings.

critical_rules.rule: Oil-based and alkyd products are PROHIBITED on alkaline concrete/CMU. Saponification is catastrophic and irreversible.
Remove form-release agents and laitance on poured concrete before coating. Adhesion failure (coating peels in sheets) if omitted.
critical_rules.enforcement: Conditional prep task in MOD_FNDN_PREP (poured only).

critical_rules.rule: Remove all efflorescence before coating. Coating over active efflorescence causes osmotic blistering.

materials_json.oil_based_blocker: Oil-based and alkyd products are PROHIBITED on alkaline concrete/CMU. Include as compatibility_rule blocker.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> finish -> cleanup (no interstage for this spec)
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_FNDN_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_FOUNDATION_WALL MUST be used exactly as registered (proposed ID)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Above-Grade Foundation Coating (Poured Concrete, CMU)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior foundation coating. Distinct from SF_MASONRY_EXT_NC (masonry walls) — foundation is a utilitarian surface with stricter MC limits (4% vs 12%), QT2-QT3 only range, ground-level access only, and narrower substrate type set (poured/CMU only, no brick/limestone).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior above-grade foundation wall surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM covers exterior foundation wall. ITM_MASONRY_WALL (proposed) covers masonry wall field surfaces. Foundation is a distinct surface category — utilitarian band at grade, not an architectural wall surface.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Foundation Wall Surface Area (SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for foundation wall net paintable area. Distinct from PS_EXT_SURFACE_SF.MASONRY_WALL — foundation is a separate measurement context (above-grade band, not full wall).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Foundation Type Enum (poured/CMU)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for foundation substrate type selection. Drives block filler requirement (CMU only), surface prep branching, and roller nap selection. Not covered by PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SUBSTRATE_TYPE_MASONRY (which includes brick/limestone not applicable to foundation).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bare new masonry (pH 12-14, alkaline)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Shared proposal with SF_MASONRY_EXT_NC. Masonry-specific bare state for cementitious substrates. Distinct from SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD and SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT — unique alkalinity, porosity, and cure requirements. Required for primer routing (alkali-resistant primer mandatory).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Grade line / soil interface (non-paintable adjacency)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Adjacency reference for foundation bottom edge termination. Not a paintable surface — documents where coating terminates at ground level.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Landscape perimeter protection zone (LF-based)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Shared proposal with SF_MASONRY_EXT_NC. LF-based landscape protection measured along foundation/house perimeter. Confirm registry addition.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkali-Resistant Foundation Primer
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Foundation-specific primer system. Same product class as SYS_EXT_MSRY_PRIMER_ALKALI but separate system for foundation-specific coverage tracking (different substrate porosity context).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Block Filler for CMU Foundation (PCA P12)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Foundation-specific block filler system. Same product as SYS_EXT_MSRY_BLOCK_FILLER but separate for coverage tracking. CMU foundation may have different void density than CMU wall.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for Foundation
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Foundation-specific acrylic finish. Flat sheen only. Different coverage rates from masonry wall (foundation surface is smaller, potentially different porosity context).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Cementitious Coating for Foundation (Drylok-type)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing system covers cementitious coatings. Unique product class — fills pores, breathable, 15 PSI hydrostatic resistance. Dramatically different coverage and production rates from acrylic.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer Coverage Profile for Foundation
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Foundation primer coverage: 250-350 SF/gal. Poured concrete higher, CMU lower.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Block Filler Coverage Profile for CMU Foundation
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Block filler coverage: 75-125 SF/gal depending on void density.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Finish Coverage Profile for Foundation
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Foundation acrylic finish coverage: 250-350 SF/gal poured concrete, 150-200 SF/gal CMU.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Cementitious Coating Coverage Profile for Foundation
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Cementitious coating coverage: 100-150 SF/gal. Thicker application than acrylic, dramatically lower coverage.
